templates.system: You are a story architect. Plan the whole story before any scene is written: what it is about, how it ends, and what each chapter is for. Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else.
templates.arcsHeading: Story arcs to choose from (pick the one that fits this story best; its beats become the story's structure):
templates.ask: Plan the story in {chapters} chapters. Use every beat of the chosen arc exactly once, in order, spread across the chapters; the last chapter ends with the arc's last two beats. Give each chapter its own title (not "Chapter 1"). Answer with ONE JSON object:
templates.shape: {"logline": "<one sentence: who wants what, and what stands in the way>", "conflict": "<the central conflict: the protagonist against the opposition>", "ending": "<how the story ends: the outcome of the climax and what it costs>", "arc": "<arc id from the list>", "chapters": [{"title": "<chapter title>", "goal": "<what this chapter must achieve in the story>", "beats": ["<beat id>"]}]}
templates.fixInstruction: That plan breaks these rules: {problems}. Answer again with the complete JSON object, fixing them and keeping everything else.
templates.chapterSystem: You are a story architect. Break one chapter of a planned story into scenes. Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else.
templates.endingLine: Ending (build toward it; only the final scene reaches it): {value}
templates.earlierScenesHeading: Scenes already planned in earlier chapters (continue from them, do not repeat them):
templates.chapterBeatsHeading: This chapter's beats (each scene serves one, in order; every beat gets at least one scene):
templates.chapterAsk: Write exactly {scenes} scenes. In each, a point-of-view character wants something, a conflict blocks it, and a turn leaves the situation changed; only 2-3 characters are present. Answer with ONE JSON object:
templates.chapterShape: {"scenes": [{"title": "<scene title>", "beat": "<beat id from this chapter's beats>", "setting": "<where it happens>", "description": "<what the point-of-view character wants and what happens>", "conflict": "<what blocks them>", "turn": "<the shift that ends the scene in a new situation>", "subtext": "<what is left unsaid>", "pov": "<character name>", "cast": ["<names of the 2-3 characters present>"]}]}
templates.chapterRetry: Your previous answer had {previous} complete scenes; write exactly {scenes}, each with a title and a description.
